interpretation_notes: The legacy probe records greedy_accuracy=0.1 on both train and test. e1 emits only つ in both splits; e10 emits only ま in both splits. The report's after CER=0.9 and exact_lines=0.1 are retained separately.

The field ctc_loss_mean is preserved verbatim. In probe.v3.go.txt:59, full_image=true replaces l with final-row softmax cross-entropy before reporting it, so the raw field name is semantically mismatched for whole-image rows.

The aligned and full_image profiles change more than timing: input representation, propagation rows, encoder initialization/trainability, effective capacity, and objective differ. The evidence does not justify attributing all improvement to sequence timing.
The 4NN comparison uses the same 200-sample development test region and 1000-sample training region recorded in baseline-knn.jsonl. It is not the final blind protocol.
All headline percentages above are derived directly from the retained JSON fields; raw rows remain in the copied JSONL logs.
